question: Technical follow-up only: exact numeric seed replay and complete output-grid comparison of the already executed repository default.

scope.species: mouse; biological development context CCl4-induced fibrosis
scope.system: nonspatial HSC populations and two collagen-I tokens; no hepatocyte, liver function or human prognosis output
scope.input: 16 TGF-beta1 pulses, initial clock day4, interval84h; surrogate for twice-weekly CCl4, not CCl4 pharmacokinetics
scope.observable: COL1 tot = high + low remodeling tokens
scope.unit: arbitrary model units related by original calibration to collagen-positive histological area; not mass or percent human fibrosis
scope.normalization: COL1 tot divided by initial COL1 tot (0.5), fold baseline
scope.time: 0 to original stop at approximately242.5 model days; nominal treatment end60, last scheduled pulse56.5
scope.published_target: Bougueon2024 Figure2B2/B3; 5% reactivated-MFB inactivation; mean cellular trajectories and10 collagen trajectories

sources.runtime: official KaSim identified by executable digest/version in runtime-lock.json; paper names4.2.12 but exact runtime identity unresolved

development: Kisseleva2012 observations used by original authors for calibration and model-family selection; text summaries12-fold at1month and approximately14-fold at2months
publication_reproduction: Bougueon2024 Figure2 and original implementation; not independent
excluded_from_independent: DMN/TAA/high-fat comparisons already examined or adapted by authors
data_partitions.rule: Split by study/protocol, never arbitrary points from same trajectory. No synthetic replacement. If none qualified, independent test is NOT PERFORMED.

calibration.reason: No verified longitudinal individual or aggregate time-series with measurement errors qualified at freeze. Original calibrated parameters remain unchanged; no optimization to match summaries.
calibration.parameters: all original values; only declared CLI condition overrides

ambiguity_policy: Repository default pool6 implies60000 molecules/cell; Figure2 caption specifies10000 so literal override1 is a separate prespecified condition, not a correction. Report both; do not pick best post hoc. Keep apparent dimensional inconsistencies in source unchanged and report them.

sampling.interpolation: last recorded state at or before requested time; report actual timestamp; do not extrapolate beyond final time

comparators.target_precision: approximate article summaries, not raw measurements;12/14 are not exact physiological truth; no invented SD or n
comparators.simple_baseline: constant baseline collagen fold1, no estimated parameters
comparators.existing_swift_demo: not scored against collagen measurements because its normalized matrix index has no measurement mapping; software behavior audited separately

metrics: MAE and RMSE of ensemble mean folds at32/60 versus quoted development summaries, descriptive only
mean, SD, min,max and empirical5th/95th quantiles across stochastic seeds
Monte Carlo standard error of mean; split-half mean difference and MC uncertainty
mechanism contrasts use fixed first5 seeds and paired endpoint differences; these are model sensitivities, not drug effects

numerical_checks.seed_replay: repeat repository_default seed101 with same arguments; compare numeric rows exactly
numerical_checks.observation_grid: repeat same seed with0.25-day output; compare common grid values; tolerance1e-8 absolute to allow CSV decimal formatting; mismatch triggers investigation, not biological rejection
numerical_checks.ensemble: report two fixed batches101..105/106..110; finite replication does not prove convergence of tails
numerical_checks.validity: finite observations; nondecreasing times; initialCOL1=0.5; full observation through240 days; report negative token/cell outputs without clamping

acceptance.software: source hashes exact, interpreter execution exit0, declared time coverage, parse/finite/order checks; run failures retained
acceptance.publication_direction: positive treatment-associated increase and post-treatment decrease reported with across-seed uncertainty; absent directions are a failed directional reproduction
acceptance.quantitative_reproduction: no binary quantitative pass from approximate text targets or uncalibrated error threshold; differences reported explicitly, exact reproduction requires archived author traces/protocol/runtime
acceptance.independent_biology: NOT PERFORMED unless separate prospectively specified study dataset qualifies in a new version; no accuracy claim

identifiability: No fitting or identification in this technical package. 43 table entries are not 43 independent free parameters; see parameter-identifiability.md.
uncertainty_separation: unknown measurement/sampling error for quoted targets

budget.stop_rule: One verified baseline reused; two new controls, each <=900s. Stop on failure; no automatic retry, no incomplete-job overwrite. Queue time separate.

changes: No data-dependent retuning or relaxed thresholds. Any amendment gets new immutable spec and explicit rationale; prior failures remain.

amendment.reason: User requested closing the budget-limited technical controls. New separate prospective budget; reuse verified completed baseline. No model or acceptance changes.
changes: technical controls prioritized; no primary ensemble rerun
